chinese: 他说的话让所有人惊讶。

english: I don't know whether he will come or not.
soundmark: /aɪ dəʊnt nəʊ ˈweðər hiː wɪl kʌm ɔːr nɒt/

english: The problem is that we don't have enough time.
chinese: 问题是我们没有足够的时间。
soundmark: /ðə ˈprɒbləm ɪz ðæt wiː dəʊnt hæv ɪˈnʌf taɪm/

english: It is obvious that he is lying.
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ˈɒbviəs ðæt hiː ɪz ˈlaɪɪŋ/

english: The news that our team won made us happy.
chinese: 我们队获胜的消息让我们高兴。
soundmark: /ðə njuːz ðæt aʊər tiːm wʌn meɪd ʌs ˈhæpi/

english: Can you tell me where the nearest hospital is?
chinese: 你能告诉我最近的医院在哪吗？
soundmark: /kæn juː tel miː weər ðə ˈnɪərɪst ˈhɒspɪtl ɪz/

grammar.text: where引导宾语从句，用陈述语序

english: Whoever breaks the law will be punished.
soundmark: /huːˈevər breɪks ðə lɔː wɪl biː ˈpʌnɪʃt/

english: I am not sure if this is the right way.
chinese: 我不确定这是不是正确的路。
soundmark: /aɪ æm nɒt ʃʊər ɪf ðɪs ɪz ðə raɪt weɪ/

english: She insisted that she should go alone.
soundmark: /ʃiː ɪnˈsɪstɪd ðæt ʃiː ʃʊd ɡəʊ əˈləʊn/

english: It doesn't matter who you are.
The question why he quit his job remains unanswered.
chinese: 他为什么辞职的问题仍未回答。
soundmark: /ðə ˈkwestʃən waɪ hiː kwɪt hɪz dʒɒb rɪˈmeɪnz ʌnˈɑːnsərd/

english: I have no idea what you are talking about.
soundmark: /aɪ hæv nəʊ aɪˈdɪə wɒt juː ɑːr ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt/

english: What we need is more practice.
chinese: 我们需要的是更多的练习。

english: It is reported that the president will visit China next month.
chinese: 据报道，总统下月将访华。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz rɪˈpɔːrtɪd ðæt ðə ˈprezɪdənt wɪl ˈvɪzɪt ˈtʃaɪnə nekst mʌnθ/

english: His suggestion that we start early was accepted.
chinese: 他建议我们早点出发被采纳了。
soundmark: /hɪz səˈdʒestʃən ðæt wiː stɑːrt ˈɜːrli wɒz əkˈseptɪd/
